ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio (~75% high-intensity white/light-gray to 25% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central low-intensity black wedge extending from the peduncle junction; continuous low-intensity black banding along the entire trailing edge and lateral tips; high-intensity white field across the primary surface of both lobes with sparse low-intensity micro-spotting.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 45-50 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5-20 pixels; more pronounced jagged peaks on the lateral 1/3 of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory from the notch transitioning to a slight convexity towards the mid-lobe, ending in a sharp upward vertical sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme lateral tips and sporadically along the trailing edge border.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, dark vertical linear pixel disruptions observed on the lower interior portion of both lobes, particularly a distinct vertical streak on the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on trailing edges and tips; minor irregular indentations along the trailing edge topography potentially representing small-scale tissue trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical black 'drip' or streak mark located on the white ventral surface of the inner right lobe.
